roll.10:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew caught up; Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the week before. Audrey’s dogs were Pepper, Precious, Panda; Andrew has no pets, loves animals (especially eagles), and hikes Fox Hollow. Audrey said she’d try it.

2 Apr: Audrey’s household adopted white puppy Pixie. Pepper was wary at first but now stays near her.

16 Apr–11 May: Andrew missed nature and wanted weekly outdoor trips/photos. Audrey enjoys dog walks, shared muffins/photos, hikes with four dogs every couple months, and suggested dog/nature tattoo and wooded dog park. Both favor positive-reinforcement training.

2–13 Jun: Audrey likes off-leash parks and nature; offered help finding pet-friendly housing. Andrew took a rock-climbing class, reached the top, and wants kayaking/bungee jumping. Audrey invited him on an hour-long dog walk; he accepted.

26 Jun: Audrey moved to a bigger-backyard home with an agility/toy area. Andrew shared a nearby indoor dog daycare photo. Audrey shared a peaceful mountain-lake hike memory; both value nature and pets as family.

3 Jul: Audrey was taking a challenging, rewarding dog-training course; her dogs improved. Andrew still couldn’t find dog-friendly rentals and was exploring cooking instead of hiking. Audrey’s four dogs are 3-year-old mutts: two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes; they’re a close pack, love running/fetch, and had a fun, chaotic playdate last Friday. Audrey shared dog photos. She loves cooking as creative, calming self-care (music, wine); favorite recipe is family chicken pot pie, evoking her grandma’s kitchen. Offered to send recipe. Garlic is her go-to ingredient; favorite garlic dish is Mediterranean-style roasted chicken with lemon and herbs, her comfort meal; offered recipe. Andrew is a cooking novice, enjoys experimenting to de-stress, and will try recipes and report back.
roll.19:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew reconnected. Andrew is a financial analyst with German Shepherd puppy Toby and a girlfriend. Audrey has four dogs—Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie—and remembers childhood dog Max.

Apr–Aug 2023: Audrey loves dog walks, nature, off-leash parks, positive-reinforcement training and agility; moved to a larger yard, does agility twice weekly, and got a tattoo of her dogs. Her four energetic mutts are two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes. She enjoys fetch, grooming and cooking (garlic staple). Andrew likes outdoor trips, photos and hiking Fox Hollow; hopes to kayak and bungee jump. Work stress limits outings. He and girlfriend camped with Toby and volunteered at a shelter. Audrey offered hikes, housing and dog-walking help.

19 Aug: Andrew took a cafe work break, shared sunset/mountain/church photo, planned reserve visit; Audrey shared grooming advice and dog photos.
24 Aug: Andrew and girlfriend went fishing; Audrey has never fished. Discussed dogs and grooming.
6 Sep: Andrew said stress reduced outdoor time; coffee/lunch walks help. Audrey advised self-care; shared dog playdate and beds. Andrew shared hike sunset/city view and hopes to hike with older Toby; struggles to find dog-friendly housing.

24 Sep: Audrey said a dog’s leash broke at park; she caught and soothed her, strengthening their bond. She advises patience, love, regular training and praise; teaches sit, stay, shake, roll over. Dogs get walks multiple times daily. Andrew seeks a close bond with Toby and shared frisbee-dog photo. They discussed dogs, then gardening: Audrey has flowers and veggie patch; Peruvian Lilies are easy-care (water, sun). Her dogs enjoy exploring the garden and play only with each other. Both say their dogs bring immense joy.
roll.28:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew reconnected. Andrew is a city-dwelling financial analyst with a girlfriend and German Shepherd Toby; he later adopted Buddy, whom Toby took time to accept. Audrey has dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie (breed descriptions have varied), and childhood dog Max. She loves dogs, walks, nature, positive training/agility; makes recycled-material jewelry and donates some profits to a shelter. She also enjoys gardening, cooking, garlic and sushi. Andrew enjoys outdoors, photography and Fox Hollow hikes; hopes to kayak/bungee jump. He and girlfriend camped with Toby, volunteered at a shelter, fished and planned a beach trip.

Oct 2023: Audrey injured her arm in a park accident and managed one-handed during recovery. She consulted an animal behaviorist about her dogs’ unusual behavior; routine changes and positive reinforcement helped.

4 Nov 2023: Andrew and girlfriend biked to a park. Audrey joined a weekly dog-owners group. Andrew had decided against a third dog for the time being; Audrey recommended dogs get exercise, socialization and mental enrichment. They value and support their friendship.

22 Nov 2023: Audrey said her dogs had been groomed the previous Friday, behaved well and looked cute; shared a grooming photo. Andrew said Toby and Buddy hadn’t been groomed yet, but he and girlfriend had adopted another dog, Scout, despite his earlier decision. They planned a nearby park outing with all three dogs, keeping Scout leashed and introducing them gradually. They bought Scout a bed, toys and puppy pads. Audrey shared a park photo of a dog with a tennis ball. Both expressed joy and gratitude for their dogs.

rebuild.10:
Andrew became a Financial Analyst the week of March 20, 2023. He loves animals, especially eagles, and nature; hiking restores him. Fox Hollow has great views. He has no pet but wants a dog; since he rents in the city, he seeks dog-friendly housing near parks/woods and thinks a small dog suits his apartment. By June 2 he was discouraged but determined; Audrey offered housing help. He browsed sites, shelters, and asked friends. He hikes most weekends; in April he explored cafés with his girlfriend. He hiked with friends May 6–7 and June 23, took a beginner climbing class June 11, and considered kayaking and bungee jumping. Unable to hike, he cooked more; he agreed to try Audrey’s chicken pot pie and roasted chicken recipes.

Audrey had dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda; adopted Pixie by April 2. By May 11 she had four dogs: two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes, all age three. They enjoy hikes, fetch, playdates, and road trips (about every couple months). Audrey uses leashes/shoes, positive-reinforcement training, and treats; a workshop was planned for June 2023. She moved by June 26 to a house with a bigger backyard and dog agility/play area. Dogs bring her joy; walking in nature is her happy place. She has a dog-and-sunflower tattoo. She likes cooking as self-care; favorite is family chicken pot pie, and she loves garlic, especially Mediterranean-style roasted chicken. She offered Andrew recipes. Audrey and Andrew discussed a future pastry party (April, no date/location) and a dog walk (June). Audrey hikes, loves nature, and shared photos of dogs, horses, and landscapes; her May 2023 national-park hike featured a sunset and birds.
rebuild.19:
Andrew became a Financial Analyst the week of 20 Mar 2023. He loves nature/hiking for peace and a reset, usually hikes on weekends, and enjoys outdoor adventures and photography. He has a girlfriend; they explore cafés, picnic, camp, fish, volunteer at shelters, and visit farms. After searching for dog-friendly housing, Andrew got Toby, a male German Shepherd puppy, by 11 Jul 2023. Toby was young and energetic; Andrew hoped to hike with him and build a bond.

Audrey has four 3-year-old mixed-breed dogs: Pepper, Pixie, Precious, Panda (two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes). She adores them, hikes/walks them, plays fetch, arranges playdates, and prioritizes training, grooming, and safety. Her new home (26 Jun 2023) has a larger backyard with agility equipment. She uses positive reinforcement and took training/agility/grooming courses. Dogs’ traits: Pepper lounges on couch, Pixie in bed, Precious has a chair, Panda a rug; they cuddle together. Audrey has dog-and-sunflower and four-dog tattoos. Childhood dog Max loved fetch and neighborhood walks.

Andrew and Audrey discussed an August 2023 hike with their dogs; no date/location recorded. Audrey enjoys cooking; favorite is family chicken pot pie, and garlic-lemon-herb roasted chicken. She gardens; on 24 Sep 2023 her Peruvian lilies looked good and vegetable patch was growing. Andrew tended balcony flowers.
rebuild.28:
Andrew: Financial Analyst since week of 20 Mar 2023; lives in city, loves hiking/nature (peaceful, restorative), birds/ecology, photography, outdoor activities. Girlfriend; enjoys cafés, cooking, picnics, board games, wine tasting, fishing. Dogs: Toby (male German Shepherd), Buddy (shelter adoption by 19 Oct), Scout (recent adoption by 22 Nov; named for adventurous spirit). City dog ownership is challenging; Scout leashed while adjusting, supplied bed/toys/puppy pads. Audrey advised gradual introductions; Andrew planned small-park outing and grooming.

Audrey: devoted dog owner, nature lover; walking dogs and cooking are calming. Four mixed-breed dogs: Pepper and Panda Labrador mixes; Precious and Pixie Chihuahua mixes. Tattoos depict dogs; uses positive reinforcement, training/puzzles, grooming, walks, playdates. Moved to home with backyard/agility area (June). Sells recycled-material jewelry, donates some profits to animal shelter. Likes gardening (Peruvian lilies), birdwatching, sushi (recommends California/salmon rolls), chicken pot pie and garlic-roasted chicken. Arm injured playing with dogs in Oct 2023; cast, recovery/care difficult. Behaviorist visit 25 Oct; routine/positive reinforcement showing progress.

Andrew and Audrey planned dog hikes in Aug, then Nov; agreed 4 Nov 2023 hike, Audrey bringing snacks; scenic dog-friendly lake trail, no name/location specified. Audrey often hikes with dogs, meets owners weekly; recommends exercise/socialization and mental stimulation. Andrew volunteered at shelter with girlfriend 24 Jul; Audrey has four dogs, deeply values them.
